## Requirements: Live-but-superseded terminal-server Relay handles

Parent #2060 / #1926 / #1645. **Scope refined after concurrent [#2100 / PR #2101](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/2101) merged at c7ea592f** and already implements exact begin/socket/route proof binding. Original duplicate [PR #2108](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/2108) is superseded; do not merge conflicting implementations.

The application terminal-server capability is a singleton and can be reinstalled on a new WebSocketService before its old service is disposed. The existing RelayServerHandle stale check only reads `service.isDisposed`: an **old still-connected handle** can send begin/end/input/resize or register ready callbacks through the *new* singleton owner, even when both physical sockets independently have the same physicalGeneration number (e.g. 1). Socket-generation equality alone does not prove service ownership.

### Scope

- Add an optional read-only identity check to the TerminalServerApi, comparing the current plugin installation surface by **object identity**.
- In relayServerHandle, fail closed for superseded-but-not-disposed services on every outbound or subscription path, while keeping optional compatibility with injected legacy mocks.
- Add a deterministic two-live-socket regression: old handle stays connected and un-disposed but cannot send, subscribe to another service's Relay proof or declare ready; new owner's handle continues functioning.
- Do **not** add ACK forwarding or reinterpret a Relay proof as xterm parser/baseline synchronization.

Parent #2060 remains blocked on verified renderer parser ACK/Agent-issued-byte credit, regardless of this non-credit proof guard.

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 Superseded-but-connected service cannot operate through the latest terminal-server singleton; new owner remains usable.
- [x] SC-02 Deterministic cross-service proof/input/route negative test, including same numerical physical generation and legacy compatibility.
- [ ] SC-03 Exact PR HEAD Quality, E2E, Case Smoke, trusted premerge Agent Acceptance and exact merge-SHA Quality/E2E/Cases/Orchestrator success.

## E2E Verification

### New
- none: no new browser scenario is needed; the superseded-live-handle fence is proven by deterministic unit tests (`relayServerConnection.test.ts`, two real sockets and same numerical `physicalGeneration`) and a React integration test (`TerminalRegion.test.tsx`), which cannot be expressed by the current browser fixtures.

### Regression
- terminal-consistency-faults
